decisions.reason: As a German chemicals firm, a vegan superfood drink mix is a weak strategic fit to the core industrial portfolio and a mere website mention suggests limited commitment.
Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions fit well with process and environmental technology capabilities, and such B2B products typically need time to build orders.
A waste oil to energy plant appears closely aligned with chemical process know-how, and having its own webpage indicates above-average strategic emphasis.
A plastic waste to fuel plant fits the circular-economy and conversion-technology space, though it carries more commercialization risk than the stronger-positioned core energy products.
